{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the shape and columns
print(df.shape)
print(df.dtypes)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Filter out invalid age values (only keep age >= 0)
valid_age = df[df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
